mechanism_narrative: The federal funds rate level is negatively correlated with S&P 500 20-day forward returns, so the current low level (0.16%) predicts positive returns.
failure_condition: When FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%, the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 7.5%, it signals a weak labor market that leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE > 7.5%, the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: When both industrial production (INDPRO) and employment (PAYEMS) are growing above 0.5% in the last month, it signals a strong economy that leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO > 0.5% and PAYEMS > 0.5% in the last 30 days
failure_condition: When INDPRO > 0.5% and PAYEMS > 0.5% in the last 30 days, the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles (defined by FEDFUNDS rising above 0.5% and staying above for 3 months), S&P 500 forward returns are negative over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: When FEDFUNDS > 0.5% for 3 consecutive months, the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: The current GDP growth rate (as measured by GDPC1) is positively correlated with S&P 500 returns, so the current growth (13616.2 billion) predicts positive returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: When GDPC1 is above the historical median, the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 95, it signals a contraction in manufacturing that leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 days.
failure_condition: When INDPRO < 95, the 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: When consumer demand (RSAFS) is growing above 0.5% and the federal funds rate is below 0.5%, it signals a strong demand environment with accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
regime_hint: strong demand and accommodative policy regime
failure_condition: When RSAFS > 0.5% and FEDFUNDS <= 0.5%, the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: During high unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 7.5%), S&P 500 forward returns are negative over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE > 7.5%, the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of cases.
